components.contract: delegateWorker(env,binding,action,data,options); wrap existing result with TAP envelope rather than replace dispatch
limitations: RPC and HTTP pathways are implemented, catalog entries alone do not prove service availability
timeout errors are generic failures, no UNKNOWN_OUTCOME
action-based dispatch audit is fire-and-forget and swallowed

components.role: Control/Execution Plane: agent loop with model/tool calls and outcome receipt classification
components.contract: runAgent; reuse runTool through TAP facade; preserve existing owner context
limitations: toolReceiptForOutcome can synthesize local UUID for arbitrary nonempty output without hash or independent verification
audit failures at 568/584 are silent

components.role: Control Plane: logical agent identities, roles and allowed tool lists
components.contract: AGENTS/agentById/selectTeam; add separate explicit least-privilege TAP manifests
limitations: most agents receive broad common tool list including mutation-like tools; server-side owner gates still apply
agent role registration does not prove independent Worker deployment

components.role: Execution Plane: tool schemas plus central dispatch and owner gates
components.contract: TOOL_SCHEMAS and runTool(env,agent,name,input,executionContext)
limitations: do not pass ownerMode/adminAuthorized from message payload
missing/unknown agent may have no tool-list gate; TAP must require registered authenticated identity

components.contract: existing diagnostic_ping tool registration delegates to runTool
limitations: MCP transport is separate from TAP identity/permissions; a successful catalog is not executor evidence

components.role: Execution Plane: skill adapters and catalog
components.contract: reuse existing skill execution adapters; no replacement registry

components.role: Control Plane: durable workflow, task/step persistence, artifact save
components.contract: TrinityOperations with ops_jobs/ops_steps/ops_events; separate TAP status map instead of changing old DB enum
limitations: legacy statuses running/completed/partial/failed; no UNKNOWN_OUTCOME
completed step reuse exists; independent proof is not required for every legacy output

components.role: Data & Trust Plane: outcome policy and lifecycle checks
components.contract: ExecutionLifecycleGuard + truthStatus; stronger TAP checksum/identity verification can be additive
limitations: lifecycle VERIFIED guard uses executorId, forbidden issuer markers and exitCode, not cryptographic provenance or result checksum
existing exitCode=0 check does not by itself prove acceptance criteria

components.contract: preserve GuardianAgent DO binding
limitations: this class only returns ACK; it is not the full evidence gate

components.contract: read-only audit; preserve current ownership
limitations: not tracked at audited SHA
not silently included in this Foundation change

components.contract: reuse runTool diagnostic_ping; enrich externally with TAP run_id, SHA256 and durable evidence
limitations: returns healthy even when ops_events insert fails silently
no run_id, persisted R2 evidence or request/result checksum today
existing chain tests Trinity/tests/tool-execution-chain.test.mjs use test DB/model fixtures, not live provider proof

components.role: Data & Trust Plane: structured D1 and R2 artifacts
components.contract: DB ops_events and ARTIFACTS.put/get are existing compatible interfaces
limitations: cloud persistence not tested in this read-only audit
same R2 bucket has several aliases; do not treat aliases as isolated stores

components.role: Data & Trust Plane: sanitized context with provenance
components.contract: reuse sanitized ops_memory/memory_long context; graph-memory and teleological_memory remain intact
existing bearer auth, capability proposals and approvals at port 8791
limitations: dirty source at shared checkout is separately owned
no /api/diagnostic-ping HTTP route found in audited baseline; do not invent it

components.contract: executeProposal(workspaceRoot,proposal,dataDir); preserve safe path policy, hash preconditions and shell:false process execution
limitations: not a general remote shell
process timeout can leave uncertain side effect state; facade must not retry blind

components.role: Data & Trust Plane: proposal FSM and JSONL audit
components.contract: ProposalStore transition uses allowed current states and atomic rename; contains per-process queue
limitations: per-process serialization is not distributed lock
recoverInterrupted marks failed without automatically replaying; map to UNKNOWN_OUTCOME in new protocol

components.role: Execution Plane: approved action leasing/receipt callback
components.contract: claimSystemAction/finishSystemAction; cloud bridge must preserve authenticated gateway identity
limitations: claimed action can be reclaimed after 90 second lease without generic effect reconciliation
finish completed requires an object receipt, not content hash verification

components.contract: preserve distinct PC_BRIDGE_V2 and PC_BRIDGE_SERVICE mappings; no connectivity claim
audit separately; do not route new agent to broad legacy shell
limitations: auditCommand blacklist is not a capability security boundary
not tested or activated here

components.contract: callModel already has Workers AI, OpenAI, Gemini, local/Ollama, Groq, DeepSeek, Anthropic, Mistral, OpenRouter
limitations: Azure OpenAI and Cohere implementations not found in this dispatcher
credentials/config presence is not authenticated capability verification
avoid replacing working callModel with stubs

limitations: no verified endpoint, manifest or authenticated identity from user text
domain currently maps to production worker; domain is not identity

antigravity.title: auru.dev is assigned to default production worker
antigravity.impact: owner target staging environment does not match current domain route; Meta task submission there could touch production
antigravity.action: explicit future infrastructure review; no binding/domain change in additive Foundation

antigravity.title: push may deploy production if repository variable enabled
antigravity.impact: TRINITY_AUTO_DEPLOY_PRODUCTION true admits production on push; variable and environment rules not inspected
antigravity.action: manual workflow_dispatch gate should replace push production branch; never push main in this task

antigravity.title: production TRINITY_AUTO_MERGE is true
antigravity.impact: conflicts with owner prohibition on automatic system/security merge; env.production also true at 281
antigravity.action: record and require explicit follow-up config ownership; staging is false at 423

antigravity.title: diagnostic ping audit insertion is silently discarded
antigravity.impact: healthy response is not evidence that audit was retained
antigravity.action: new TAP facade must fail proof verification when durable audit write/read-back fails

antigravity.title: delegation audit is not awaited and swallows persistence failure
antigravity.impact: service dispatch success can have no durable audit
antigravity.action: await new TAP storage boundary; preserve old path initially

antigravity.title: tool success and failure audit writes swallow errors
antigravity.impact: receipt list can claim completion without persisted execution audit
antigravity.action: TAP must include awaited trusted receipt persistence; old engine remediation separate

antigravity.title: legacy lifecycle has no unknown outcome and weak VERIFIED binding
antigravity.impact: exitCode and executorId alone cannot prove result/content/acceptance criteria
antigravity.action: add TAP1 state machine with UNKNOWN_OUTCOME terminal/no blind replay and checksum verification

antigravity.title: Ollama tunnel branch contains hardcoded fallback bridge credential
antigravity.impact: source-known fallback is not a secret; no live exploitation attempted and no value included here
antigravity.action: separately owned fail-closed credential removal; do not activate provider path

antigravity.title: staging service bindings share production service names
antigravity.impact: separate D1/R2 alone do not establish full staging isolation; Vectorize indexes also shared
antigravity.action: no authenticated staging agent calls until isolation owner review

antigravity.title: expired claimed action may be leased again
antigravity.impact: side effects may duplicate if execution succeeded but finish response was lost
antigravity.action: preserve current path; add idempotent reconciler before migrating mutating TAP tools

antigravity.title: agent tool membership is broad
antigravity.impact: membership alone is not least-privilege; server owner gates mitigate some mutations
antigravity.action: independent authenticated per-agent/environment/tool scopes in TAP facade

antigravity.title: provider fallback paths omit branch-specific diagnostic detail
antigravity.impact: Ollama local/cloud fallback correctly fails overall if unavailable, but original failure context is lost
antigravity.action: structured sanitized branch logging; do not treat all fallback catch blocks as correctness bugs

antigravity.title: interrupted proposal reports failed rather than unknown
antigravity.impact: does not auto replay (good), but cannot assert no side effect occurred
antigravity.action: TAP mapping to UNKNOWN_OUTCOME with manual reconciliation

antigravity.title: GuardianAgent DO is an ACK transport only
antigravity.impact: must not infer full trust verifier from class name
antigravity.action: use explicit verifier module rather than rename or remove legacy class

morpheus.finding: Staging has TRINITY_AUTO_MERGE=false but root/production true (84,277); staging DB/DB aliases use trinity-development, secondary D1 trinity-db and trinity-pc-bridge remain shared (447,452), R2 ARTIFACTS/TRINITY_STORAGE/R2 all trinity-artifacts (463-465). Domain name cannot be accepted as proof of isolation.
Production job can run on push when vars.TRINITY_AUTO_DEPLOY_PRODUCTION=true, in addition to manual dispatch. No change or workflow invocation made by audit.

ExecutionLifecycleGuard accepts an object with executorId and exitCode=0 unless issuer=llm_model/forged=true; no trusted issuer binding, checksum, artifact/readback or task/run/result binding. Static finding only; exploit test not executed.
Delegation audit write errors swallowed with catch(()=>{}); Guardian record does same at Trinity/services/guardian.js:37. Failed persistence may leave transport success without reliable audit.

Many logical agent roles share broad tools, including finance, self-deploy and shell names. runTool has separate owner/admin guards, so this is overly broad role declaration rather than proof every caller can execute them.
recoverInterrupted marks executing as failed and avoids retry, but cannot distinguish definitely failed vs unknown side effects; TAP UNKNOWN_OUTCOME adapter needed.
No diagnostic_ping, trinity.agent.v1, ToolExecutionReceipt or UNKNOWN_OUTCOME string found in JS/MJS/SQL audit search. Do not cite the pasted example diagnostic/ping.ts path as existing.
Meta Facebook/Instagram OAuth exists with read scopes. No auru-dev-agent implementation/verified Meta AI agent API found; user greeting/ID text is not identity/authentication evidence.

contract.verification_scope: local contract tests reported by root; final test logs govern

facade.verification_scope: existing runTool diagnostic_ping plus local Miniflare D1/R2 integration tests; no deployed verification

storage.verification_scope: applied only in local disposable test storage

limitations: Schema and checksum establish shape/content integrity, not independently authenticated external issuer identity. The new facade trusts server-supplied principal/grant and executor-owned storage.
No existing HTTP or MCP host invokes this opt-in facade yet.
No cloud receipts or public R2 URLs were generated.
Azure OpenAI/Cohere adapter additions and live provider availability checks are deferred.

verification_tests.independent_review: ACK R1-R4 resolved, reported by root
